sections.section: ORDER - High Court Judges (Travelling Allowances) (Amendment) Order 1979
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 10 OF 1979
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 10 OF 1979
HIGH COURT JUDGES (TRAVELLING ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 15th July, 1979]
No. F. 17(2)/79-Pub.-The
following Order made by the President on the 10th July, 1979 is hereby published
for general information :-
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the High Court Judges (Travelling Allowances) Order, 1965 (P. O. No. 4
of 1965), for the purposes hereinafter appearing:
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of the fifth day of July, 1977, read with the Laws
(Continuance in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A. Order No. 1 of 1917); and in
exercise of all powers enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to
make the following Order :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the
High Court Judges (Travelling Allowances) (Amendment) Order, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of paragraph 7, P. O. No. 4 of 1965.-In the High Court
Judges (Travelling Allowances) Order, 1965 (P. O. No. 4 of 1965), hereinafter
referred to as the said Order, in paragraph 7, for the words "one
rupee" the words "one rupee and twenty-five paisa" shall be
substituted.
3. Amendment of paragraph 11, P. O. No. 4 of 1965.-In the said
Order, in paragraph II,---
(a) in clause (1),-
(i) for the word
"forty" the word "fifty-five" and for the word
"Sundays" the word "Fridays" shall be substituted ; and
(ii) in the proviso, for the word
"forty-five" the word "sixty-five" shall be substituted ;
and
(b) in clause (2).-
(i) after the word
"hotel", occurring for the first time, the commas and words,
"Inspection bungalow or Inspection lodge or in a guest house, rest house
or residential club" shall be inserted ;
(ii) for the words "hotel
receipts or vouchers" the words and commas "receipts or vouchers of
the hotel, Inspection bungalow, Inspection lodge guest house, rest house or
residential club" shall be substituted ;
(iii) in paragraph (a), for the
word Twice the words "Three times" shall be substituted ; and
(iv) after the words "Equal
to" the words "one and one half times" shall be inserted.
